text: {"lessons":["My account fell from about 101,235 to 86,551 before recovering slightly; short-term fluctuations are not reliable forecasts of what comes next.","Doing nothing avoided impulsive trades, but I should still periodically check whether my holdings remain consistent with my goals and risk tolerance.","I should judge each position on its future prospects and portfolio role, not on its average cost or my reluctance to admit a loss."]}
